messages:
elaine: quick report — customers hitting surprising behavior when porting REST examples to SDK (js 0.8.1). noticed three things: param names differ, streaming flag not always honored, and auth-retry on streams is missing.
peter: can you give a minimal repro?
elaine: REST curl: `curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-rt-1\",\"input\":\"long text\",\"stream\":true,\"temperature\":0.7,\"max_new_tokens\":150}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` works fine.
elaine: same in SDK: `client.generate({model:'redwood-rt-1', input:'long text', stream:true, temp:0.7, maxTokens:150})` — observed issues: SDK accepts `temp` & `maxTokens` but docs show REST names; mixing names confuses sample apps.
sam: mixing param names will break analytics, especially if ingestion expects canonical REST names.
peter: streaming flag ignored? how often?
elaine: a code path in SDK runtime falls back to non-streaming for large-batch requests if `stream:true` is set but some headers aren't present. Happens intermittently.
sam: worst is auth refresh mid-stream. REST clients seem to detect 401 chunk, refresh token, and resume stream. SDK currently terminates stream with `Error: stream closed (401)` and surfaces to app without retry.
peter: do we have request id or idempotency token?
elaine: yes, generate accepts `request_id`. Server will allow replay if same `request_id` provided. SDK isn't passing request_id into reconnect logic.
sam: proposal: add a thin compatibility layer in SDK input parser that maps `temperature`->`temp`, `max_new_tokens`->`maxTokens`, `top_p`->`nucleus` and emits one-time warning log when alias used. Also implement streaming auth-reconnect using `request_id` and make it opt-out via `streamingRetry: false`.
peter: agree. Add unit + integration tests: force-expire token mid-stream and assert SDK reconnects. Update examples README to show canonical SDK names and alias mapping note.
elaine: i'll open issue and add failing test in `examples/ci/stream_auth_reconnect.sh`.
devex-bot: created issue #524: "SDK parity: param aliasing + streaming auth reconnect + example fixes"
devex-bot: Issue #524 created by elaine: "Map REST params -> SDK names, add optional streaming retry with request_id replay, update examples and telemetry"
sam: telemetry request: emit events `sdk_alias_used` and `sdk_stream_reconnect` so we can count usage and failures during canary.
peter: plan: patch branch, implement shim + reconnect, tests, canary for 48h, then patch release 0.8.2.
elaine: tagging @docs for README updates and @observability for telemetry panels. thanks.
